subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia smiled after dropping the barrel.
source_quote: I drop the barrel down, and smile.

subject: Glannon
fact: Glannon looked at the barrel.
source_quote: Glannon looks at the barrel.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tried to figure out if Glannon was mocking her.
source_quote: I look at him, and try to figure out if he is mocking me.

subject: Glannon
fact: Glannon realized his mistake.
source_quote: He realizes his mistake, "No, I didn’t mean it that way."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia thanked Glannon.
source_quote: I thank him.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia noticed that Quinna was both smiling and worried.
source_quote: I can’t help but notice that she’s both smiling and worried.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia mused that the animated broccoli sounded ridiculous but offered more adventure.
source_quote: I muse "Bouncing around the village, causing chaos? Sounded a bit ridiculous, but hey, more adventure, right?"

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia thought, "Let it go, it's just a broccoli."
source_quote: Part of me thought, "Let it go, it's just a broccoli."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia wondered what to do when the broccoli went into the apothecary.
source_quote: I’m thinking now that what am I going to do.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia considered firing a firebolt but feared setting the apothecary on fire.
source_quote: Firebolt it? No, then the whole place might catch fire.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia rolled to hit the broccoli and it collapsed.
source_quote: I roll, and I can’t remember if I hit, but yes, I do and it just kind of collapses.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia heard voices but realized it was only the owner looking bewildered.
source_quote: I think I hear a couple of voices, but no, just the owner looking bewildered.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia thought, "It’s just the life, I guess. Never a dull moment."
source_quote: It’s just the life, I guess. Never a dull moment.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr shouted, "Bouncing potatoes," and ran after them.
source_quote: "Bouncing potatoes," I shout to Seqoia and run after them.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noticed the potatoes stared at him as if taunting.
source_quote: The potatoes stare at me as if taunting me.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr grabbed one potato while the other two paused as if angry.
source_quote: I grab one, and the other two pause as if angry.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr stabbed the potato in his hand.
source_quote: So I take my knife and stab the one in my hand.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr wondered if animated potatoes can cry or feel anything.
source_quote: I wonder if animated potatoes can cry, or feel anything, and decide that’s not my problem.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr stuffed the potatoes into a bag and they didn’t move.
source_quote: Taking advantage of horror, I grab them and stuff them into a bag. Terrified, they don’t move around in the bag.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr ate the potato and felt blessed.
source_quote: And a few hours later, the potato is in my belly. And I feel blessed.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr said, "You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison."
source_quote: "You served me well, potato. And you were certainly more filling than that rat I caught in that prison."

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee coughed.
source_quote: Palsmarie Clee coughs.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee asked if she had walked into the Inn or was always there.
source_quote: Has she walked into the Inn, or was she always there?

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee showed the map and said the caravan didn’t take the standard road.
source_quote: "Let me show you on the map where the caravan was. They didn’t take the standard road, the fools. Go there, follow the bandits, and get the honey."

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee said she didn’t know who did it.
source_quote: "I don’t know."

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee said the survivors said the attackers chanted 'Black Earth' and carried stone weapons.
source_quote: The guards who survived said that the attackers chanted ‘Black Earth’ and carried weapons of stone.

subject: Palsmarie Clee
fact: Palsmarie Clee said the guards had all left town.
source_quote: They have all since left our town.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia’s eyes revealed a momentary flash of pleasure.
source_quote: even his eyes reveal a momentary flash of pleasure.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia observed the wagon site littered with overturned wagons, broken barrels, and scattered honey jars.
source_quote: The wagon is precisely where she said. The site is littered with overturned wagons, broken barrels, and scattered honey jars.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia noticed the ground was churned up.
source_quote: The ground is churned up.

subject: Calmer
fact: Calmer shouted, "Magic was used here, or something very big. This isn’t just a bunch of brigands."
source_quote: Calmer shouts, "Magic was used here, or something very big. This isn’t just a bunch of brigands."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia found large footprints leading away from the road.
source_quote: Soon found many valuable clues. Large footprints lead away from the road.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia wondered what could be so big and cause so much harm.
source_quote: Looking at the footprints, I wonder what could be so big and cause so much harm; whatever it is, it isn’t something good.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia shouted, "Magic." and pointed at faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks.
source_quote: I shout, "Magic." Calmer rushes up to me, and I point at faintly glowing runes etched into the rocks.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia nodded to Sequoia and agreed the cultists were responsible.
source_quote: Zinnia looks at me, and I nod, "This is not bandits. This must be the cultists we are looking for."

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia worried that falling rocks were not an accident.
source_quote: I am worried that the stones were not an accident, but we find nothing.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia said, "Sometimes a rock is a falling rock."
source_quote: "Sometimes a rock is a falling rock," I say.

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia whispered, "These are the guys."
source_quote: I whisper, "These are the guys."

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr observed Thalsor stepping forward with a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals.
source_quote: I watch as he steps forward, his hands tightening around a stone staff adorned with jagged crystals.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor said, "You think yourselves heroes?"
source_quote: "You think yourselves heroes?"

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor said, "The very stones you trample upon are older, stronger, and far wiser than any of you could ever hope to be."
source_quote: "The very stones you trample upon are older, stronger, and far wiser than any of you could ever hope to be."

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor said, "You call yourselves adventurers, but all I see are fools and thieves, unworthy of the honey you dare to steal back."
source_quote: "You call yourselves adventurers, but all I see are fools and thieves, unworthy of the honey you dare to steal back."

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor laughed harshly and echoed through the cavern.
source_quote: His laughter that echoes through the cavern, harsh and unyielding.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor said, "Come then, insects. Let me show you the futility of your struggle. Let me show you what it means to face the unbreakable will of stone!"
source_quote: "Come then, insects. Let me show you the futility of your struggle. Let me show you what it means to face the unbreakable will of stone!"

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr thought, "How the heck did he know that?"
source_quote: I think, "How the heck did he know that?"

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr saw two muddy creatures appear beside Calmer.
source_quote: suddenly two muddy creatures appear right beside Calmer. Mud men.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noted that when the mud men went down, they exploded and made it so you couldn’t move.
source_quote: When these mud men go down, they kind of explode, make it so you can’t move.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor tapped a stone thing and it came alive as a Stone Golem.
source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor ranted about the honey and the earth.
source_quote: He starts ranting again about the honey and the earth

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor tried to negotiate and offered to trade anything but giving up the honey.
source_quote: then suddenly shifts gears and tries to negotiate. Weird guy. Offers to trade, anything but giving up the honey.

subject: Thalsor
fact: Thalsor conjured up a storm of sharp stones.
source_quote: He conjures up a storm of sharp stones.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr managed to dodge most of the stone storm but it still stung.
source_quote: I manage to dodge most of it, but it still stings like hell.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr noted that Thalsor was barely alive and the golem was still a threat.
source_quote: Thalsor's barely alive, and the golem’s still a threat.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr got an advantage because of his rogue training.
source_quote: I get an advantage because of my rogue training

subject: Sequoia
fact: Sequoia went to town on one of the bandits with a flurry of attacks.
source_quote: Sequoia just goes to town on one of the bandits—absolute flurry of attacks.

subject: Zephyr

source_quote: I chip in where I can, finishing off the bandits when I get the chance.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia laid into the bandits with serious force and called it a flurry of blows.
source_quote: Zinnia follows, just laying into the bandits with some serious force. Flurry of blows, he calls it, multiple attacks

source_quote: Calmer hits it with some kind of holy spell, deals a ton of damage

source_quote: Has she walked into the Inn, or was she always there?

subject: The identity of the attackers
fact: The identity of the attackers is unknown, though Palsmarie Clee suspects they are not bandits.
source_quote: I don’t know. Gnonsbim says they are bandits. I don’t think so.

subject: The location of the Black Earth Temple
fact: The exact location of the Black Earth Temple is not yet known, though the encampment in the Kron Hills is suspected.
source_quote: It’s built into a shallow cave on a rocky outcrop in the Kron Hills.

subject: The origin of the animated vegetables
fact: The origin of the animated broccoli and potatoes is unexplained.
source_quote: some of the ingredients were animated and they rushed into the village.

subject: The nature of the Stone Golem

source_quote: He taps this stone thing and – bam – it comes alive. Stone Golem, they call it.
